title: Adobe Creative Cloud 60% off $44.99/Month ($539.88/Year) @ Adobe
body:
Deal: Adobe Creative Cloud 60% off $44.99/Month ($539.88/Year) @ Adobe

[bchliu] Adobe.. Commercially predatory and borderline malware that self installs crap without consent.
Glad Artcraft exists.
[BestTechAdvisor] Interesting how much support ArtCraft is getting in this thread given how anti-AI people are on most threads
[BestTechAdvisor] How so? I get that there's slop, but I've seen well made products get negged if people think they use AI.
I'm guessing that people are just accepting of AI in ArtCraft because they dislike Adobe even more than they dislike AI.
[gilbarc] @BestTechAdvisor: Well yeah, it's turning the tech industry's weapons back against them. The schadenfreude is 😙👌
[conza] I can't wait for Adobe to be just a bad part of history.
ArtCraft is still free, right?
[MasterScythe] Yep!
IMO, even if it weren't, $5 a month or something to support tokens for continued refinement would still be of value to a great many.
Hopefully it won't ever come to that, I'm just musing.
[duckduckering] I first read that as 60% off $44.99p/m and not $44.99p/m being the actual discounted rate. If you're not already suck in Adobe's ecosystem avoid like the plague. They've proven time and time again they'll nickle and dime wherever they foreseeably can.
Even before the perpetual subscription model we were getting shafted. Back when Adobe suite was a retail box it used to be cheaper to catch a plane to the US, buy a copy off the shelf, and fly back than it was to buy it outright in Australia.
[itsfree] All true. Unfortunately, I still haven't found anything better than Acrobat Pro. (I haven't paid for it after I lost the sub through my work account tho)
[MasterScythe] To do what specifically?
You should see how easy the new PDF tools they added to Firefox makes eveything.
My whole workplace has practically abandoned adobe for firefox PDF tools.
[jaackyy] What exactly do you need it for??
Go to ArtCraft and get PDFCraft from them for free. It’s fully open source and built from the ground up. Does everything acrobat pro does
[itsfree] Thanks, I had heard about this, but didn't realise they'd created an Acrobat dupe too… Will give it a try!
[nightelves] @itsfree: It's literally a dupe of PDF Pro.
[Vladdo] Yeah.. I can remember working in an ad agency and we needed creative suite and at the time, it was like $3k or something per seat.
I found someone from the US willing to ship copies on CD to us for like $300 a seat. I emailed BSA (Business Software Alliance) and ask them if it was legal to use software out of region. They gave me a number of excuses in buying only from Adobe AU, they eventually said that it's not illegal, i just wouldn't get any technical support.
We did even consider getting on a flight, buying a number of cheap copies in LA, and getting on a plane back. Thankfully we didn't have to resort to that.
Adobe can get stuffed!
[M00Cow] WTF? How is that a bargain?
Dear <insert code bot> Create me an Adobe Creative Suite programme.
Your fav AI bot pro will do it all for 1/2 that price/mth. There are so many people in marketing and advertising who have dropped Adobe for Claude and said it does it all and more for half the price. In fact one of my mates said he can do Photoshop-type alterations to massive amounts of images in a day, what used to take 3 to 4 weeks to do on Adobe at a fraction of the price. F-Adobe and their dodgy practises . Trying to cancel is a bloody nightmare. They go around loops and loops and loops and they'll try to frustrate you into just giving up so they can keep billing you.
[jstris] is it wrong for me to take photos and want to edit them personally instead of using an ai bot pro?
[M00Cow] if you want to be an Adobe apologist, knock yourself out.
[Sfh1975] No. Do you want me to tell you a number of free better alternatives? Start with darktable, i would say. something simpler? raw therapee. or UFRaw. digikam for your DAM.
[BestTechAdvisor] Yeah, if you use AI to build a Photoshop, Lightroom, etc alternative, it will mostly be looking at FOSS projects like GIMP and Dark table and copying their homework.
Better off just using those existing FOSS projects and forking or contributing to them.
[jaboday423] Time to move on from paid subscription where possible, thanks to ArtCraft and the team behind it.
https://getartcraft.com/apps
[Vladdo] I just had a go at Lightcraft, the Lightroom replacement. It needs substantial work before it gets close.. but, it's a start.
[M00Cow] there's always alternatived, but there's already Adobe apologists
https://havecamerawilltravel.com/workflow/free-lightroom-alt…
[BestTechAdvisor] There's never been a useable alternative to LRTimelapse until vibe coding came along. Even now, the alternatives still aren't great and have a lot of downsides. Last I checked, I couldn't find any that were non-destructive.
I'm sure that'll change with AI, but this is just one example of "there's always alternatives" not being the case.
[Vladdo] I understand that there are alternatives, but they're all rubbish by comparison. Specifically, AI denoise and AI Masking which i use heavily. Even the AI/Facebook masking feature in Lightcraft is completely useless, so will be stuck on LR for now but hopefully, Lightcraft will get much better.
[Referenced] I quite like affinity as well if you only need a photoshop equivalent. https://www.affinity.studio/photo-editing-software
[theoofside] No thanks. It's an annual plan billed monthly, meaning if you want to cancel after a month you have to pay out the whole year.
[He-Mania] I hate Adobe - even with the free acrobat reader thr crap it installs on your Windows PC in the background. Installed the vib coded 'craft' suites now. Too early to tell how good they are
[M00Cow] Isn't it funny the Adobe apologist/marketing team are on here negging comments. Adobe have been appalling for 25 years. No excuses for supporting them.
[Scottbmcg] Ugh the comments here are so smug / edgelordy. Its expensive and there are great alternatives but this is a good deal if you want industry standard professional software.
[AdModnar] insert "current" before "industry standard" and I think you might get more agreement from those who commented earlier.
Time will tell how long that remains true though
[jaackyy] For 90% of use cases, the person on the other end does not know or care whether or not you used Adobe Acrobat to view/edit/comment on a PDF.
The only real exception would be using Digital Verified Signatures to sign important documents.
But that's generally for large corporate businesses, unlikely to be the small business owner, tradies, students etc on ozbargain.
[M00Cow] no, Adobe have been industry worst practice for over 25yrs. that's went so many people aare rejoicing at having an alternative these days.
this is an overly expensive price for f-all innovation over 10yrs. They've been relying on deceitful practices for over 15yrs to keep people subscribed.
can you cancel your subscription easily? previously you couldn't and had to call up, go thru high pressure sales tactics just to cancel.
humans hate Adobe for a reason.
[FullPricePhobic] Lol, I had access to full Adobe clould suite through a free short course I enrolled with a TAFE.
[compound] Adobe treats their customers and users like trash. Good riddance.
[meong] negative vote to highlight that cancelling the plan before the contract ends require you to pay the remaining monthly payments
